comment: task circuit-chain-recipes — the circuit synthesis-chain Press band (MultiItemTechnological.java:546-770) via the SECOND press file key (the sawing.json size-split ruling; press.json keeps the b1 lamp/TNT stock + the electrode rows). 205 rows = 15 statement blocks expanded over the PORT-universe walks (live dump 2026-10-04): Plate Empty walk :548-553 = ANY.SiO2 {22 members, all dust-true} x ANY.Plastic {5, all plate-true} = 110; :573-581 = 7; Cu parts :597-610 = ANY.Cu {AnnealedCopper, Copper} x 12 = 24; :611-616 = 6; Magic :618-629 = 12 (Thaumium/Manasteel/Mithril/Netherite all wireFine-true); :630-636 = 7; Ender parts :638-649 = 12; boards :674-698 = 23; crystal processors :767-770 = 4. All rows 16 EUt; 64 t for plates/boards, 16 t for parts. The lens bands of the chain (wirings/crystal circuits) live in laserengraver.json; the soldering band lives in bath.json; the :765 Crystal Socket crafting row is the MTE crafting 'C' column = the machines-domain card (declared out).
